scenario: Cache verbs are language primitives per LIMP.9.7 — `cache`, `cache_delete`, `cached(...)` do not require an import. Pin: a rule using `cache` compiles cleanly without any `import storage` directive (the cache plane is built into the grammar, not surfaced through a stdlib library).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    cache key: "k" value: t.v
